label: Closed-loop gain
subgoals: Multiply the forward gain by the feedback factor to get the loop gain
Divide the forward gain by one plus the loop gain
Compare the result with one over beta

label: Crossover of a one-pole loop
subgoals: Set the magnitude of the loop gain to one
Solve for the crossover frequency of the single pole
Approximate it as the DC loop gain times the pole frequency

label: Phase margin of a two-pole loop
section: Phase margin of a two-pole loop
subgoals: Solve the magnitude of the loop gain equal to one for the crossover
Sum the phase contributions of both poles at the crossover
Subtract that sum from 180 degrees to get the margin
